summary: Frontend-only E2E review completed for boot, navigation, theme, hero, profile, projects, contact, certifications, and mobile layout.

ui_bugs.issue: IST / Hyderabad status and live clock are clipped at the right edge because the mobile hero remains a row flex layout; content is visually inaccessible despite overflow being hidden.

integration_issues.issue: Submission only displays a local staged/sudo confirmation and does not send to a backend or email API (MOCKED API).

action_items: Set the mobile hero layout to a vertical flex direction or otherwise place .hero-status within the viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form is intentionally local-only: clearly communicate this behavior or wire a real submission integration if required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop core flows passed. Boot skip, navigation buttons, theme toggle, clock population, resume/contact CTAs, all three README toggles, sudo and normal staged confirmations, five certification links, and mobile width check were exercised. Mobile screenshot showed hero status clipped; rerun responsive hero after fix.
rca of the issue: At max-width 650px, .hero changes sizing but does not set flex-direction: column. The desktop .hero display:flex row behavior remains, so .hero-copy consumes the row and .hero-status is laid out beyond the viewport; .app overflow:hidden masks it rather than allowing access.
